value: Red about #C8202A for stamps, pins and accents (estimated)
Blue label about #2F4E8C and yellow label for the last chapter (estimated)
Vignette: panel corners fall to about #AAA79C

value.description: Small roman-numeral label in spaced capitals on a pale paper strip, top left in every panel, at about 7% of width. It is the film's only constant type.

Changes per chapter. Scraps of mixed faces, blackletter, a heavy newspaper Didone, condensed slab capitals in red, and finally a stacked wide sans with colour misregistration. About 30-45% of frame width.
Italic pen script written on with a quill for one line; a circle drawn by hand round the last word.
Red condensed numerals in a rough rectangle, rotated about 8 degrees, about 7% of width. These slam on.
Small typewriter or condensed text on white torn paper strips, always rotated by a few degrees and offset from the object they label.
Black heavy condensed figures on a torn white strip, about 40% of width, with a small label beneath.

composition.value: Scrapbook on a page. A subject cut-out, generally about 40% of the frame's height and off-centre, with the rest placed around it during the chapter until the panel is full. Nothing is aligned on a grid: objects sit at small angles, each with a thin white sticker edge and a soft shadow. Each panel has a printed frame line, and a gutter of about 3% of width separates panels. Final sheet is 4 by 2 panels under a masthead.

materials.value: Grainy aged paper with folds and stains, different in each panel. Engraving-style black and white figures with white die-cut edges. Photograph-like colour objects only near the end of the story. Red ink spatter. Tape on the top edge of some pieces.

lighting.value: No light moves. A fixed soft vignette and a shadow under each piece; the paper texture does not move with its pieces, as far as these frames show. One heat effect: the tiles and block glow orange at 13.5-14.7 s.

styleSummary: An eight-panel paper scrapbook that fills itself in time with the voice. Engraved cut-outs, real-looking paper, red stamps and typography that changes with the era.
